images.name: weather
images.prompt: Create an original premium art-directed web illustration for PayGate, a pay-per-call API product. Match the attached reference only in its deep ink black, luminous violet #735CFA, pale lavender #9A90FF, fine optical filaments and rare cool cyan highlights. Contemporary high-end motion design, exquisite clean lighting, dimensional and alive, not a screenshot or website mockup. No writing, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, interface, labels, border or frame. No metal, chrome, concrete, machinery, coins or cyberpunk city. Background is almost black #080612 with delicate purple atmospheric light, not a grey photographic studio. SUBJECT: a weather forecast made tangible as data. One beautifully formed soft translucent lavender cloud, luminous sun disk half visible behind it, a few delicate glass raindrop shapes descending below; the recognisable weather symbol is built from thousands of extremely fine luminous strands and softly frosted translucent volume, not a toy or clip-art icon. A precise thin elliptical ring of tiny data points orbits the cloud horizontally. Fine pale violet data streams curl into the bottom of the cloud. Large object at x=53%, y=48%, occupies 60% width and 62% height, generous dark space around all edges. Floating weightlessly in an infinite dark violet environment with no ground or pedestal. Colorful violet light on the cloud, tiny near-white highlights, cyan only 3% of the image. Lighting is warm lavender in front and deeper purple behind, cinematic volumetric depth but crisp silhouette. 4:3 landscape. Quiet top 18% and bottom 15% for native HTML overlays added later.

videos.name: weather
videos.prompt: Animate this exact luminous violet weather-data artwork. Locked-off camera, identical composition, no camera travel, zoom or cut. The cloud retains its readable silhouette and center position. Fine filaments gently stream through the cloud from lower left to right; the dotted elliptical data orbit progresses slowly around it; a few light raindrops drift down a short distance and dissolve. The sun softly radiates, never flashes. Subtle 1-2% buoyancy only, no dramatic morph, no explosion or new objects. Preserve black negative space, violet/lavender palette and fine texture. Premium slow motion-graphics loop designed behind native website text. Start and end match. Silent.

videos.name: path
videos.prompt: Animate this exact panoramic violet data-river environment with a fixed camera and absolutely stable framing. Thousands of hair-fine optical filaments flow steadily from left to right along their existing curved tracks. Three shallow light pools gently breathe sequentially left, center, right; occasional tiny light particles advance with the streams. Keep the upper half nearly black and quiet for interface overlay. Motion is visible but smooth and restrained; no large wave swelling into the upper half, no zoom, cut, horizon shift, objects, writing, or UI. Preserve dark ink/violet/lavender palette. Elegant continuous 8 second atmospheric loop; start and end match. Silent.

processing.images: Pillow Lanczos WebP quality 88, weather 1400px / access and path 1600px; mobile 800px; no compositing.
processing.video: FFmpeg 24fps H.264 CRF23 fast preset, faststart, no audio. 0.4s wrap crossfade (main source 0.4–8.0s plus source head 0–0.4s at offset7.2). Weather1200px, path1600px.
